assumptions.statement: AOI is the chosen EPSG:3067 rectangle [385200,6671300,386500,6672500], 1.3 × 1.2 km. Vertical heights retain Helsinki N2000.
assumptions.rationale: A metric local analysis with explicit XY reprojection from EPSG:3879.

assumptions.statement: City flights 11–15 June 2021, nominal nadir density 40 points/m². Data do not assert present-day conditions.
assumptions.rationale: Epoch pinned to an explicitly open CC BY 4.0 survey.

assumptions.statement: DTM: mean class 2 ground and class 8 keypoints per 1 m cell; GDAL inverse-distance FillNodata up to 60 m. Beyond that remains unknown.
assumptions.rationale: Ground below buildings must be interpolated; no invented replacement city geometry.

assumptions.statement: Obstruction DSM: DTM plus maximum class 6 buildings, class 17 bridge deck, and classes 3/4/5 vegetation only at least 2 m above DTM. Unknown classes are excluded.
assumptions.rationale: Measured 2.5D opaque canopy/roof columns; no windows, underpasses or canopy permeability.

assumptions.statement: DTM quantization 0.1 m rounded, DSM quantization 0.1 m rounded up. Unknown values are 65535. Source units are metres.
assumptions.rationale: Compact browser payload with conservative obstruction rounding.

assumptions.statement: SIMULATED UAVs follow sourced OSM route shapes at 8 m/s, 50 m AGL by default. They do not represent observed flights or forces.
assumptions.rationale: User-requested illustrative simulation; not operational intelligence.

assumptions.statement: Five minute prediction samples each 60 s under three equal speed hypotheses 0.8/1.0/1.2. Yellow means ≥0.25 of hypotheses find any sampled visibility for at least one vector.
assumptions.rationale: Uncalibrated scenario weights; brief visibility between samples can be missed.

assumptions.statement: Target is 2 m AGL; zone display samples at 20 m spacing. LOS traverses every crossed 1 m DSM cell. Missing/obstructed targets stay unknown.
assumptions.rationale: Coarse target sampling bounds CPU cost; GREEN does not establish safety.

assumptions.statement: Browser computation is exploratory over published rasters. Vectors, paths, readout and overlay share one timestamped worker snapshot. Reset returns to t=0 and manifest defaults.
assumptions.rationale: Avoid misleading correspondence between current movement and an older zone result.

assumptions.statement: Vegetation is treated as opaque for the June 2021 epoch; seasonality and classification errors change actual visibility. Earth curvature/refraction and sensor detection physics are omitted.
assumptions.rationale: The model estimates geometric line of sight only, at neighbourhood scale.

assumptions.statement: Building rendering is a replaceable source-backed mesh layer, separate from the unchanged 1 m LiDAR DSM. Vegetation is a deterministic subsample of measured returns; UAV props are magnified 9× for legibility.
assumptions.rationale: Display simplification and annotation sizes do not change 1 m obstruction calculations.

assumptions.statement: Surface OSM graph excludes tunnels, bridges, nonzero layer, private/no motor access and non-motor road types; oneway tags are respected in route construction. Reversal at route ends is a simulated turn.
assumptions.rationale: A simplified street-following demonstration, not a routable operational movement planner.

assumptions.statement: MGRS is a one-metre display reference in WGS84; internal metric analysis remains EPSG:3067/N2000. Entered references select the grid-square centre; the ETRS89/WGS84 display approximation is not survey positioning.
assumptions.rationale: Separate coordinate notation from analysis and disclose datum/display precision.

assumptions.statement: Past traces cover elapsed simulation time up to 120 s. Future route and terminal speed envelope use 0.8/1.0/1.2 speed scenarios over 300 s. The 16 m wide visual ribbon is an annotation of along-route terminal uncertainty, not a lateral accuracy bound.
assumptions.rationale: Distinct past/future styles, real source vertices and explicit scenario uncertainty.

assumptions.statement: Official Helsinki untextured LoD2, tilesetVersion 291269823412, HTTP export 2026-05-11; acquisition epoch is unknown for this continuously maintained model. 15 leaf b3dm tiles are decoded, reprojected, triangle-clipped and quantized to 2 cm for display. LiDAR DSM remains the sole obstruction input.
assumptions.rationale: Real roofs and source IDs with explicit display-versus-analysis provenance; epoch differences are measured, not fitted away.

assumptions.statement: Relative UAV contacts use EPSG:3067 grid north, 6400 mil per turn and N2000 height above stationary OWN at DTM + 2 m. Local true bearing is grid bearing plus meridian convergence at OWN. Range rate is horizontal, negative closing; course is the outgoing ground-track segment, not body heading. Magnetic declination and vertical velocity are not modelled.
assumptions.rationale: Explicit reference frames and signed simulated quantities; no inferred own orientation or clock directions. All contact fields share the LOS snapshot.
